adjudication.rationale: The frozen WHO 7A41 leaf is obstructive sleep apnoea, a recurrent sleep-related upper-airway obstruction. This article describes that mechanism, adult and child presentations, assessment/testing limits, airway/weight treatments, medicine population limits and follow-up across all 14 bilingual dimensions; it is not limited to a symptom or obesity-only presentation. Adult UK testing and US drug rules are explicitly scoped, not applied to children.
exclusions_considered: Central sleep apnoea 7A40 has a different signaling mechanism and is a differential, not counted.
Sleep-related hypoventilation, isolated snoring, insomnia and obesity remain separate; links and mentions do not count as independent coverage.
No claim to cover entire chapter 07 or every sleep-disordered-breathing manifestation.
